title: M10: UI overhaul (shadcn/ui, Tailwind, Radix Colors) and per-user settings
description: Intent: As the student, I want a polished, consistent interface whose colors I can choose, so that the tutor feels like mine. Includes: Tailwind and shadcn/ui components on Radix primitives, a design system built from Radix Colors scales, a configurable color theme as the first per-user setting (cool, warm, neutral), light and dark mode following the system setting with a light/dark/system choice only inside Settings (no obvious toggle), Monaco and terminal themed to match. Persistence starts in localStorage keyed by user behind a settings-store interface; server-side sync (so settings follow the student across devices) is a follow-up. Excludes: new features; this is a restyle plus the settings mechanism. DoD: all existing behavior and specs unchanged and green; themes and modes verified in a real browser; text contrast meets WCAG AA in every theme and mode.
right_now_summary: The team is adding per-user settings, backend sync, and theme controls while the IDE follows system mode.
